changelog: Added x86_64 build for emulators and Intel/AMD Chromebooks, with its own full Linux environment download (GitHub)
Added multiple Antigravity accounts: save your Google accounts and switch between them in Settings → Antigravity → Account & CLI
Added pinning chats to the top of the chat list, for every agent
Added Gemmy, a floating buddy that reacts while your agent works (turn it off in Settings → Appearance)
Added EGM (Elephant-Goldfish) design reviews: install it and manage its /egm commands from Settings
Added Account & CLI pages for Antigravity and Codex: sign-in, install, update and restart in one place
Fixed a crash while typing with some keyboards
Fixed a crash when an SSH terminal failed to connect right away
Fixed typing not reaching the terminal on emulators
Fixed Claude Code messages failing after the sign-in expired, the app now asks you to sign in again
Fixed Codex and OpenCode still showing "not found" after they were installed
Fixed Antigravity showing Error during every server restart, and dropping offline for a moment on a busy phone
Improved the Accounts dialog: simpler, with a Settings button for each agent
